summary: The bounded evidence register and entity boundary are reconciled; material missing economics remain OPEN, so downstream research is not approved.

claims.text: Heidelberg Materials announced annual Brevik CCS capture design capacity of around 400,000 tonnes of CO2.
limitations: An issuer design-capacity announcement is not verified annual delivered capture, permanent storage or avoided emissions.
It does not establish realized cement premiums, retained allowance savings, grant proceeds or operating costs.

source_register_review.analysis: One primary issuer announcement was read by the session AI and registered with its publication date, retrieval date and capacity locator. This is not independent human review.

boundary_reconciliation.analysis: The metric belongs to Brevik announced design capacity within Heidelberg Materials. It is not group emissions, realized capture, avoided emissions or a financial input.

material_gaps.analysis: No realized volumes, premium contracts, current executed grant terms, operating costs or market quotes are registered. OPEN MATERIAL issue ECONOMICS preserves those gaps. COMPLETE describes the scoped intake structure only.

issues.description: Actual captured and stored volumes, realized premiums, executed support terms, retained carbon benefits and operating costs are unavailable in this single-source review.
